title: LangWatch: Track your Claude Code Usage or Codex, OpenCode and others | Product Hunt
excerpt: You know what Claude Code costs per seat. But do you know which sessions burned the budget, which model did the work, or whether your cache paid off? LangWatch now tracks every Claude Code session: tokens, costs, cache hits, bash commands, MCP tool calls, file edits, and full terminal replays. Works with Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI, and opencode. Free for individuals. Start with: npx langwatch claude
